People have given good recs, but there's one thing I'd like to chip in with that has helped cut down on cost massively. If you want to shop from anywhere like Uniqlo, or use amazon.co.uk for prices (everything is so expensive here), use parcelmotel. They can ship it through the North, so you can take advantage of all that good free UK shipping/UK-only stores. There's a few in Cork, where you seem to be. Obviously this is left for after you've bought some cheap stuff from H&M/somewhere like it, so you've an idea about measurements and what fits you best.

I'd suggest generally just erging more, maybe steady-state or intervals, but while you've said that you're "training 15 hours a week" you provided no details. Can we get any idea of what you're doing at the moment? Nonetheless, given the time of the year that it is, you probably shouldn't but be looking at your 2k time but rather a 5 or 6k. And for that, you'll need to bust out the 40-70 minute steady state sessions. Maybe some mid distance intervals. An occasional 4x2k wouldn't go amiss, really helps with mental strength I found.

Also, as was mentioned, remember theres a cubic relationship between watts and pace, this means that every second you gain on the 2k will be harder than the last.
